fact: Presidential Order No 050/01 of 02/08/2023, published in the Official Gazette of 3 August 2023, governs the National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda, including its Board of Directors, under the NISR law.
title: Official Gazette n° Special of 03/08/2023: Presidential Order n° 050/01 of 02/08/2023 governing the National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda
publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda
